messages:
lina: quick heads-up 1: new embed run for ArborLite-v1 landed on staging. did a quick quality sweep against docs-small and web-snippets.

lina: initial numbers look odd: recall@1 down but recall@50 roughly parity. cluster purity dropped on a couple of product-related clusters.

tom: can you paste the exact eval cmd?

lina: sure:
```
eval_tool run --model ArborLite-v1 --dataset docs-small --split holdout --metrics recall@1,recall@10,recall@50,cluster_purity,umap-coherence --index faiss_ivf64_hnsw --norm l2
```

jiang: used ivf64+hnsw? that's a bit aggressive for 128-d vectors. might blur nearest neighbors for sparse short queries.

lina: i suspected index could be a factor. ran flat brute-force on a 5k sample: recall@1=0.542 vs prod=0.618; recall@50=0.881 vs prod=0.893. so degradation concentrated at top ranks.

priya: top-rank drop suggests embedding space is noisier for exact matches. did you check tokenization or embedding norm distribution?

lina: tokenization matched preprocessing pipeline. norms show median norm=0.88 (prod=1.15). variance reduced too. nearest-neighbor gap (1st-2nd distance) smaller -> less separation.

jiang: sounds like representational collapse for high-frequency anchors. whats training regime? any curriculum changes or new losses?

lina: training diff: swapped contrastive scheduler to cosine-decay, added online hard-negative mining (ohnm) with weight 0.6, and ran with batch 4096. excerpt:
```
loss: contrastive
ohnm_weight: 0.6
batch_size: 4096
temp: 0.1
```

tom: Ohnm can improve hard-case recall but sometimes pulls close negatives into clusters, hurting exact-match precision. Could reduce ohnm weight or add margin.

priya: try two quick ablations: (A) inference L2 norm + whitening, (B) retrain checkpoint with ohnm_weight=0.3, (C) quantized int8-perchannel artifact test to rule quantization.

lina: queued ablations. also adding an ad-hoc top-20 seed set of product short queries (40 items) to watch.

(eval-bot): job queued: jb-9021 (A:whiten+norm) jb-9022 (B:ohnm0.3) jb-9023 (C:int8-perchannel)

lina: quick flat results for (A) whitening+norm: recall@1 improved to 0.581, recall@10=0.735, silhouette+umap coherence up slightly. not fully back to prod but better.

jiang: that suggests post-hoc normalization helps. could be embedding magnitudes changed due to batchnorm/scale differences in last layer. any model weight diffs?

lina: compared final linear layer scale (weight norm) vs prod: mean weight norm ~0.94 vs prod 1.2. smaller weights could compress outputs.

priya: ok plan: (1) try small lr-finetune of last linear (1 epoch) to restore scale, (2) retrain with lower ohnm weight, (3) add a tiny implicit margin in contrastive loss. also add automatic seed-run to our regression checkers.

tom: also add a metric to CI: top-5 exact-match overlap for short queries. triggers if drop >3% relative.

lina: will implement. ill post jb updates when (B) and (C) finish. thanks all.

(eval-bot): jb-9022 complete 1: recall@1=0.603 (ohnm0.3) | recall@50=0.887 | note: last-linear-ft applied, small gain. jb-9023 complete: int8-perchannel artifact recall@1=0.597 (close to float).

lina: nice. with ohnm0.3 + last-linear-ft we reach recall@1=0.611, still slightly below prod but within acceptable delta for canary. schedule A/B test with 5% traffic?

priya: yes agree, run small canary and watch short-seed set and top-5 overlap alert.

jiang: add logging for per-query neighbor-rank histograms so we can catch this early on future bring-ups.

lina: added. closing the sync, will follow-up with canary results tomorrow.
